title: AI Engineer
summary: Build the AI systems behind our products and services — LLM apps, retrieval and agents — and keep them running for the clients who depend on them.
responsibilities: Design and ship LLM-powered features: RAG pipelines, agents, tool use and workflows
Own evaluation: test sets, metrics and regression checks before every release
Take systems to production with sensible latency, cost and monitoring
Run and improve the AI-powered services we deliver for clients
Work directly with clients to turn fuzzy problems into measurable ones
requirements: 2+ years building software that reached real users
Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, retrieval or agent frameworks

title: Full-Stack Engineer
summary: Build the interfaces, APIs and integrations that put our AI products and services in front of enterprise users.
responsibilities: Ship product features end to end across React / Next.js and Node or Python services
Integrate AI pipelines with client systems, data stores and auth
Keep things fast, accessible and observable in production
requirements: Comfortable with TypeScript, React and a backend language of your choice
Experience with cloud deployment (AWS, GCP or Azure)

title: AI Solutions Consultant
summary: Be the bridge between clients and our team — scoping engagements, shaping AI-powered solutions and services, and seeing them through to value.
responsibilities: Run discovery with client stakeholders and map where AI pays off
Scope pilots and service engagements with clear success criteria and timelines
Partner with engineering through delivery and handover
requirements: 3+ years in consulting, solutions engineering or technical product roles
Working understanding of modern AI capabilities and their limits
Confident presenting to senior business and technical audiences

title: AI Research Intern
summary: Six months on a real problem with a mentor — prototyping, benchmarking and writing up what you learn.
responsibilities: Prototype and benchmark approaches for an active client or product problem
Read papers, reproduce results and report findings clearly
requirements: Currently studying or recently graduated in CS, maths or a related field
A project, notebook or repo you're proud of

title: Full-Stack Intern
summary: Six months shipping real features with a mentor — from the interface to the API to the database.
responsibilities: Build and ship features across React / Next.js frontends and Node or Python services
Help connect our AI systems to the apps, dashboards and services clients use
Write clean, tested code and learn how production systems are run
requirements: Currently studying or recently graduated in CS or a related field
Comfortable with JavaScript / TypeScript and the basics of React
A project, app or repo you're proud of
